entries.wording: ENVÍO ADMITIDO EN ADMINISTRACION POSTAL LIMA
entries.note: The office that accepted the item follows EN.

entries.wording: ENVÍO SIN OBSERVACIÓN POR LA ADUANA DEL PERÚ
entries.note: Peruvian customs let the item through. Seen on a domestic item too.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN PROCESAMIENTO EN SEDE CENTRAL DE SERPOST
entries.note: Sorting at Serpost's head office, on the test item the page's script names.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN PROCESAMIENTO DE DISTRIBUCIÓN EN EL DOMICILIO DE DESTINO
entries.note: Preparing the round to the addressee's home.

entries.wording: ENVÍO LLEGÓ A LA OFICINA POSTAL DE PRUEBA
entries.note: The delivering office received the item. The tracker follows the office's name with its address and an invitation to collect the item there through the office's WhatsApp number, which the adapter drops; this office is the one of the test item the page's script names.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN PROCESO DE DISTRIBUCIÓN
entries.note: The page's note under it says the item will be delivered to its address.

entries.wording: ENVÍO ENTREGADO
ENVÍO ADMITIDO.
entries.note: A message of the tracking page's former script.

entries.wording: ENVÍO LLEGÓ A SERPOST. NO DISPONIBLE PARA ENTREGA.
entries.note: An item from abroad handed to Serpost in Peru; the page shows it with a landing plane. A message of the tracking page's former script.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN TRÁNSITO HACIA DESTINO. NO DISPONIBLE PARA ENTREGA.
entries.note: A message of the tracking page's former script.

entries.wording: ENVÍO RUMBO AL PAÍS DE DESTINO
entries.note: The item left Peru for the country it is addressed to; the page's former script called this code "ENVÍO SALIÓ DE PERÚ."

entries.wording: ENVÍO SALIÓ DE PERÚ.
entries.note: The item left Peru. A message of the tracking page's former script.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN TRÁNSITO AL AEROPUERTO INTERNACIONAL JORGE CHÁVEZ.
entries.note: On the way to the Lima airport. A message of the tracking page's former script.

entries.wording: ENVÍO SUJETO A TRÁMITE ANTE ADUANA. NO DISPONIBLE PARA ENTREGA.
entries.note: Held for customs formalities. A message of the tracking page's former script; it covers several event codes (005, 016, 031, 040).

entries.wording: ENVÍO DISPONIBLE PARA ENTREGA O RECOJO.
entries.note: Available for delivery or collection at an office. A message of the tracking page's former script; it covers event codes 035 and 066.

entries.wording: INTENTO FALLIDO DE ENTREGA.
entries.note: A message of the tracking page's former script; it covers event codes 008 and 019.

entries.wording: ENTREGADO.
entries.note: A message of the tracking page's former script.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN PROCESAMIENTO EN LA SEDE PRINCIPAL DE SERPOST - NO DISPONIBLE PARA ENTREGA
entries.note: Shown in the Serpost tracker output quoted by an open-source client's README.

entries.wording: ENVÍO EN TRÁNSITO HACIA LA ADMINISTRACION - NO DISPONIBLE PARA ENTREGA
entries.note: Shown in the Serpost tracker output quoted by an open-source client's README.

entries.wording: SALIO A DISTRIBUCION
entries.note: Shown in the Serpost tracker output quoted by an open-source client's README.

entries.wording: SE INTENTO ENTREGAR PERO FUE IMPOSIBLE
entries.note: Shown in the Serpost tracker output quoted by an open-source client's README.

entries.wording: FUE ENTREGADO
entries.note: Shown in the Serpost tracker output quoted by an open-source client's README.
